title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Genesis Root and Authenticated-Continuity Bootstrap Extension
problem_statement: A chained checkpoint architecture requires an explicit first element. The first trust object cannot prove itself by referring to an earlier object that does not exist, and later objects cannot retroactively manufacture that predecessor without changing the declared genesis boundary.

new_primitives.GENESIS_DECLARATION_ID: Identifier for the first authenticated-continuity declaration.
new_primitives.GENESIS_ROOT: First externally witnessed binding of host, initial state, verifier, policy and trust registry with previous_checkpoint_ref=null.
new_primitives.GENESIS_SEQUENCE: Initial monotonic coordinate of authenticated continuity.
new_primitives.PRE_GENESIS_CLAIM: Memory or imported state referring to events before genesis; preserved but not authenticated merely by inclusion.
new_primitives.BOOTSTRAP_POLICY_ID: Policy describing who/what may attest the genesis root and which assumptions are accepted.

pre_genesis_memory_policy.promotion_requirement: Separate source binding and evidence appropriate to the claim.

implementation_tests: genesis object with non-null previous checkpoint fails schema
later forged predecessor fails against external genesis attestation
pre-genesis imported memory remains non-authoritative until separately admitted
genesis verifier measurement tamper is detected
root rotation after genesis chains to prior epoch rather than replacing genesis
epistemic_boundaries: Genesis root defines the beginning of authenticated continuity, not the origin of existence.
The initial trust ceremony contains explicit assumptions and cannot be proven from nothing.
Initial state integrity does not prove every initial memory is true about the world.
canonical_lines: Every chain needs an admitted first link.
Genesis says where authenticated continuity begins, not where existence began.
Do not invent a parent for the root.
